title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer and your letter of 22 September.

Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.26 (po:4500013373-10) to EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10) between 2026-01-02 and 2026-09-18. That rise is already in our price. AS-14404 fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%. PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%.

The attached packages offer you a longer fixed commitment of 23,700 pieces per year over 24 months. This gives you volume planning security and less renegotiation work. Is there a cheaper variant, for example in bar finish or delivery batch size, that would lower cost further?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have reviewed the recent index developments you cited and can pass on these reductions in our new offer. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.

We welcome the 24-month volume commitment; however, for a contract of this length, we must include an AS-14404 index clause to manage material price volatility. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Our current offer features a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit.

Regarding your technical inquiry, the current bar finish is the most economical standard, though larger delivery batch sizes could yield minor logistical savings. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 - revised packages including AS-14404 clause
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for accepting the index data we sent.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

We accept your point on material volatility, so two of the attached packages include the AS-14404 clause you asked for. All three cover 23,700 pieces per year over 24 months with 90 days payment, which gives you planning security and steady volume.

Which of the three packages would you prefer to make your primary offer?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 - revised packages including AS-14404 clause
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We appreciate your acceptance of the AS-14404 index clause, which is necessary for a 24-month commitment.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. As an alternative option, we can offer a reduced price of €5.20 per unit if we agree to a 30-day payment term, alongside a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
